map.Center of Force Platform，咬合力中心，反映合力在牙弓中的: Center of Force Platform, the centre of bite force, reflects the spatial position of the resultant force in the dental arch; a deviation from the midline or an abnormal front-back position signals an unbalanced occlusion.
map.→ 打开咬合接触平衡点分析器工具: -> Open the occlusal contact balance point analyser tool
map.不能。本工具用于理解力分布概念与手工数据复核，正式咬合分析以 T-Scan 等设: No. This tool is for understanding the concept of a force distribution and manually checking data; a formal occlusal analysis relies on equipment such as T-Scan and a clinician's examination.
map.修复体戴入后咬合不适，导入力分布数据，工具算出咬合力中心偏患侧，提示需调改早接触: The restoration feels uncomfortable when worn; enter the force distribution data and the tool shows the centre of bite force shifted to the affected side, indicating that the early contact needs adjusting.
map.可能提示早接触、修复体高点、偏侧咀嚼或关节问题，需结合临床与 T-Scan 等检: It may point to an early contact, a high spot on the restoration, unilateral chewing or a joint problem, and must be judged together with the clinical findings and checks such as T-Scan.
map.咬合接触平衡点分析器 使用指南: Occlusal contact balance point analyser usage guide
map.左右不平衡说明什么？: What does a left-right imbalance indicate?
map.模拟 T-Scan 力分布数据，计算咬合力中心(COFP)与左右/前后平衡性，辅: Simulate T-Scan force distribution data to compute the center of occlusal force (COFP) and left-right / front-back balance, supporting occlusal adjustment.
map.种植修复后监测合力分布，避免种植体周围过载。（结果仅供口腔健康科普与自我初筛参考: After implant restoration, monitor the force distribution to avoid overload around the implant. (Results are for oral health education and self-screening only; they do not replace dental examination, imaging such as periapical radiographs or CBCT, or professional diagnosis and treatment by dentists, orthodontists or periodontists. With toothache, bleeding gums, ulcers that will not heal, abnormal oral mucosa or occlusal discomfort, see a dentist at a proper hospital promptly.)

map.颞下颌关节紊乱患者评估左右平衡，左右力差过大提示偏侧咀嚼习惯。: For patients with temporomandibular joint disorder, assess left-right balance; a large force difference suggests unilateral chewing habits.
map.：输入：左侧咬合力 80N，右侧咬合力 40N\n计算：左/右比 = 2.0，咬:
: Input: left occlusal force 80 N, right occlusal force 40 N
Calculation: left/right ratio = 2.0, the center of occlusal force (COFP) is left of center
Tip: a left-right difference above 30% counts as unbalanced; consider occlusal adjustment or checking for unilateral chewing.
